split: For evaluation ending year Y, fit through Y-2 and calibrate on Y-1.
embargo: Only games from UTC days strictly before forecast day minus one day update features.

variants.opponent_adjusted: V1 plus online opponent-adjusted offensive and defensive efficiency differences
variants.observed_continuity: V1 plus prior-team returning minute share, incoming-transfer minute share, prior player minutes experience and known-rotation coverage differences

decision_rule: Development shortlist only: lower pooled Brier and log loss, lower Brier in at least 2 of 3 folds, and pooled accuracy no more than 0.2 percentage points below V1 replay. No tuning or automatic promotion.
limitations: Player appearances establish observed in-season rotation, not preseason roster availability.
No current-game appearances, final-season rosters, injuries or inferred opening-day transfers.
Previously inspected 2026 historical season is not reopened.
Historical Division I and overtime-pace limitations inherited from V1.
production_policy: No edits to V1 bundle, historical evaluation, live UI, prospective snapshots or grading.
